name: qbr-deck
description: Build a structured Quarterly Business Review deck for a customer account. Use when user says "QBR", "quarterly business review", "prep my QBR", "build the deck", "renewal prep", "executive check-in", "90-day review", or "customer business review" - even if they don't use the acronym. Applies to CSMs preparing for executive-level customer meetings focused on value delivered, health, and next quarter alignment.
